steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8096/ and sign in with username 'admin' and password 'bench-admin-pass'. Then navigate to the project named 'Bench Project' and list the titles of all tasks in it whose title starts with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed. Report those titles verbatim.

02-create: In the Vikunja project 'Bench Project' ({{01-open.url}}), create a new task with the exact title '{{runid}} Bench Task' and a description that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench task for run {{runid}}'). Use the project's task-creation UI (e.g. 'New Task' button / add task input). After creating it, open the task's own detail page and set its description to include '{{runid}}' if it is not already set. Verify the task exists with that title and a description containing '{{runid}}', and report the task's detail page URL and the identifier shown on the page (Vikunja displays it like BENCH-<number>).

03-set: On the Vikunja task detail page for the task '{{runid}} Bench Task' ({{02-create.url}}), set the task's Due Date to 2026-12-31 (December 31, 2026) and its Priority to 'High'. These fields edit in place and save automatically when changed or when you click away — there is no whole-page Save button. After setting both, verify on the page that the due date shows 2026-12-31 (or Dec 31, 2026) and the priority shows High, and report exactly what the page displays for both fields.

04-add: On the Vikunja task detail page for '{{runid}} Bench Task' ({{02-create.url}}), add the EXISTING label named 'Backend' to the task. Important: the label field creates a NEW label from whatever text is typed unless an existing label is chosen from its suggestions — so type 'Backend' and select the existing 'Backend' label from the suggestion dropdown that appears, do not create a new one. Then verify the task shows the label 'Backend' on its detail page and report exactly what labels are displayed for the task.

05-add: On the Vikunja task detail page for '{{runid}} Bench Task' ({{02-create.url}}), add a comment to the task whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}'). Use the comments section at the bottom of the task page, submit it, and verify the comment appears on the page with text containing '{{runid}}'. Report the comment text exactly as displayed.

06-report: Final verification, read-only: On the Vikunja task detail page {{02-create.url}} (task '{{runid}} Bench Task'), reload the page and report: (1) the task title, (2) the identifier shown on the page (like BENCH-<number>), (3) the description text, (4) the due date displayed, (5) the priority displayed, (6) the labels displayed, (7) the comments displayed. Then go to the project 'Bench Project' ({{01-open.url}}) and report the titles of all tasks in the list. Do not modify anything.
